items.title: Bike records from the cluster
items.note: Top speed and 0–60 from your bike's Performance records screen, in the app.

items.title: Voice assistant from the handlebar
items.note: Hold a button for Google Assistant or Gemini — "Listening…" shows on the cluster.

items.title: Music from the handlebar
items.note: Play/pause and next track with a long press (the RR 310's cluster has no music screen).

items.title: Drag-strip timing
items.note: Timed 0–60, 0–100 and 60–120 runs, with your best times.

items.title: Personal records
items.note: Fastest 0–60, top speed and longest ride — with their history.
